title: b11639: opencl: support CLAMP on non-contiguous views (#30186)
summary: The clamp kernel indexed source and destination as one flat contiguous array, so a strided view as input (the new CLAMP v=1 case) read the wrong elements. Add a strided kernel_clamp_nc, as the other unary ops have, and take it whenever the source is not contiguous.
